annotations.title: Traverse Structural Agent Context on HydraDB

description: Walks multi-hop AST call/import/env edges and temporal SUPERSEDES lineage in HydraDB to assemble a bounded context slice without burning tokens on full-file stuffing.

asOf.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for point-in-time historical graph replay.

engine.description: Traversal backend: "hydradb" (default OpenCypher structural retriever) or "selfgraph" (@hydradb/selfgraph Personalized PageRank & asOf/knownAt replay).

includeBrickOntology.description: When true (or when targetStack/targetChannel/requiredPorts are provided), also queries the 4-Axis Brick Ontology (SoftwareStack, DataPort, Channel, MoEProfile) and :GOVERNS downstream AST callers.

query.description: Engineering task or question to ground structurally.

requiredPorts.description: Optional canonical or namespaced data ports for 1-to-2-hop brick composition (e.g. ["ledger_event", "audit_record"]).

targetChannel.description: Optional 4-Axis Ontology channel filter (e.g. webhook:stripe, webhook:github, workspace:gmail, telemetry:timeseries).

targetStack.description: Optional 4-Axis Ontology runtime stack filter (node-esm, typescript-node, python-fastapi, react-vite, cloudflare-edge).

name: hydrascope_traverse_context
